entities.name: ITH12674
observations: Melatonin-sulforaphane hybrid designed for dual drug–prodrug action; oxidative-stress neuroprotection was associated with reduced ROS and increased GSH/Nrf2-antioxidant response (PMID:25425158).

entities.name: PMID:25425158
observations: The primary study reports that ITH12674 was designed as a melatonin-sulforaphane hybrid with a dual drug–prodrug mechanism and protected cortical neurons and hippocampal slices in oxidative-stress models.

entities.name: ITH12674 oxidative-stress protection
observations: In vitro oxidative-stress models: ITH12674 concentration-dependently protected cortical neurons, reduced ROS, increased GSH, enhanced Nrf2-ARE transcription, and protected hippocampal slices from oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation; abstract does not detail direct prodrug cleavage/release evidence (PMID:25425158).
